claims.claim_vi: In the US, tech companies usually run payroll via the Automatic Clearing House (ACH); ACH handles retail transactions, is part of the American retail payment systems and processes transactions in batches, not in real time.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Step 0: before using the ACH network the originator must open an account at a commercial bank, since only banks may initiate ACH transactions directly; that bank is the ODFI (Originating Depository Financial Institution); the transaction receiver must authorize the originator for certain types of transactions.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Step 1: the originator company originates salary payment transactions and sends them to a third-party processor like Gusto, which helps with ACH-related services such as generating ACH files.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Step 2: the third-party processor generates the ACH files on behalf of the originator and uploads them to an SFTP established by the ODFI, by the 7 PM cut-off time specified by the ODFI bank.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Step 3: after normal business hours in the evening the ODFI bank forwards the files to the ACH operator for clearing and settlement; there are two operators, the Federal Reserve (FedACH) and EPN (Electronic Payment Network, run by a private company).
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Step 4: the files are processed around midnight and made available to the receiving bank RDFI (Receiving Depository Financial Institution). Step 5: the RDFI operates on the receiver's accounts per the instructions; in the example the receiver gets $100, done when the RDFI opens at 6 AM the next day.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: ACH is a next-day settlement system: transactions sent out by 7 PM arrive the following morning; since 2018 Same Day ACH lets funds move on the same business day.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: That the lesson speaks of the American system only, and that times are the source's example, is the author's caution.
claims.verified_by: Author's general knowledge; not checked against payment-industry documentation.

design_notes_vi: Hai lược đồ ba bên theo hai chặng của buổi tối (công ty tới ngân hàng gốc, rồi qua nhà vận hành tới ngân hàng nhận), một khung hai bước cho buổi sáng, một khung ghi nhớ. Giờ chốt, nửa đêm và 6 giờ sáng được giữ nguyên như nguồn.
source_deviations: The source writes times as 7 PM and 6 AM; the lesson writes 19 giờ and 6 giờ sáng.
The source says "US" and names FedACH; the lesson writes "Hoa Kỳ" and "Cục Dự trữ Liên bang" to avoid a mixed-case name that embeds an abbreviation.
Step 0 (opening an account at a bank, receiver authorization) is kept in the text and not drawn.
The lesson says the third-party processor is named Gusto only in the text (as the source does) and not in the figure.
